name: Dr. Tammy Good
bio:
Dr. Tammy Good is a seasoned Project Manager with over 30 years of experience in municipal engineering and construction management. Serving as the Capital Improvement Plan Manager for the City of Pompano Beach since 1998, she has led the development and execution of strategic infrastructure projects. Dr. Good holds a Doctorate in Business Administration from Keiser University and a Master's in Construction Management from Florida International University. She has over 15 years of experience as a university professor, specializing in project management, business operations, construction, safety, and sustainable design. Dr. Good holds professional credentials including Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified General Contractor (CGC), LEED AP BD+C, and OSHA Authorized Trainer certification.She is also certified in Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), stormwater inspection, and water distribution systems, showcasing her deep commitment to public safety and environmental responsibility.
A dynamic and inspiring leader, Dr. Good blends field expertise with academic rigor, making her a pivotal figure in both municipal development and construction education.
